source.title: Northern Whig, 20 September 1946, p. 3 ("Rural council nominations")
source.publisher: Northern Whig (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Whitehouse result from the Belfast News-Letter (5 October 1946, p. 3); unopposed returns from the Northern Whig (20 September 1946, p. 3).

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 3 October 1946. Whitehouse was the only contest; the other eight divisions were unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Party (w19-fixes2, 19 Nov 2026): the recorded UUP rested on a printed label 'U.' that the Northern Whig list of 20 September 1946, p. 3 (page image, w19-bna-fix) does not print for this council, so Party_As_Printed is cleared. No party is recorded (unknown), as there is no consistent evidence: he has no other return in the division.
